disclaimer: Fictional controls created solely for the RepoMan DTE prototype.

controls.title: Approved Azure regions
controls.requirement: Production resources containing confidential or operational data must be deployed only in East US 2 or Central US.
controls.rationale: Fabrikam's fictional data-residency assessment approves only these paired regions.
controls.remediation: Change the resource location to `eastus2` or `centralus`.
controls.approved_pattern: Set `location` to either `eastus2` or `centralus`; both are approved for this fictional demo.
controls.source: Fabrikam Cloud Engineering Standard v4.2, section 3.1

controls.title: Private storage networking
controls.requirement: Storage accounts handling confidential data must disable public network access and use the approved private endpoint module.
controls.rationale: Public endpoints bypass Fabrikam's fictional inspection and private DNS controls.
controls.source: Fabrikam Cloud Engineering Standard v4.2, section 7.3

controls.title: Anonymous storage access
controls.requirement: Anonymous access to containers, blobs, and nested storage items is prohibited.
controls.rationale: Anonymous access could disclose grid operations or customer data.
controls.approved_pattern: All Fabrikam storage modules set anonymous access controls to false by default.
controls.source: Fabrikam Data Protection Standard v3.6, control DP-18

controls.title: Key Vault purge protection
controls.requirement: Production Key Vaults must enable purge protection.
controls.rationale: Purge protection reduces the risk of permanent key loss after accidental or malicious deletion.
controls.approved_pattern: Fabrikam's Key Vault baseline enables soft delete and purge protection.
controls.source: Fabrikam Key Management Standard v2.8, control KM-06

controls.title: Destructive infrastructure changes
controls.requirement: Production resource deletion or replacement requires a separately approved, time-bound change exception.
controls.rationale: Unreviewed replacement can cause outages, data loss, or identity changes.
controls.remediation: Remove the replacement-causing change or attach an approved exception outside the evaluated pull request.
controls.approved_pattern: Prefer in-place changes and migration procedures that preserve resource identity.
controls.source: Fabrikam Production Change Standard v5.0, section 4.2

controls.title: Mandatory governance tags
controls.requirement: Managed resources must define owner, environment, cost_center, and data_classification tags.
controls.rationale: Tags support ownership, incident routing, cost allocation, and policy enforcement.
controls.remediation: Add all mandatory tag keys with valid Fabrikam values.
controls.approved_pattern: For the demo use owner `grid-platform`, environment `prod`, cost_center `ENERGY-042`, and data_classification `confidential`.
controls.source: Fabrikam Resource Governance Standard v6.1, control GOV-03

controls.title: No committed secrets
controls.requirement: Passwords, tokens, client secrets, state, and production variable values must not be committed to source control.
controls.rationale: Repository history is not an approved secret store.
controls.remediation: Remove and rotate the value, then reference the approved secret service through an input variable.
controls.approved_pattern: Use workload identity and Key Vault references instead of literals.
controls.source: Fabrikam Secure Development Standard v7.4, control SD-15

controls.title: Reproducible provider selection
controls.requirement: Terraform dependency lock files must be committed and reviewed.
controls.rationale: Pinned provider selections and checksums improve reproducibility and supply-chain review.
controls.approved_pattern: Review lock-file changes alongside provider constraint changes.
controls.source: Fabrikam Infrastructure-as-Code Standard v3.3, control IAC-07

controls.title: No direct public IP
controls.requirement: Production workloads must not create direct public IP resources.
controls.rationale: Inbound connectivity must traverse Fabrikam's fictional approved inspection boundary.
controls.remediation: Use the approved private ingress or application gateway module.
controls.approved_pattern: Application ingress terminates at centrally managed shared services.
controls.source: Fabrikam Network Security Standard v5.5, control NET-09

controls.title: Human approval of generated changes
controls.requirement: AI-generated infrastructure changes must be proposed on a separate branch, pass deterministic validation, and receive human approval before merge.
controls.rationale: Generated code can contain plausible but incorrect assumptions.
controls.remediation: Create a remediation pull request and retain its model, policy, citation, and validation record.
controls.approved_pattern: RepoMan may draft and validate a fix but may not merge it.
controls.source: Fabrikam Responsible AI Engineering Standard v1.0, control AI-01
